subject: URGENT: Investigation Request – Suspicious SSH Activity
body:
Good morning,

Our monitoring systems detected an unusual increase in SSH authentication attempts against one of our production Linux servers during the early hours of this morning.

At this stage we cannot confirm whether the activity represents an unsuccessful brute force attempt or a successful compromise.

Your task is to perform an initial investigation before any containment actions are taken.

Please analyze the available system artifacts and determine what occurred.

Do not make assumptions.

Support every conclusion with evidence collected from the system.

Further instructions will follow in a separate email.

Regards,

Sarah Mitchell
Security Operations Center

subject: Investigation Deliverables
body:
Investigator,

Your initial investigation has been approved.

Please proceed with a detailed analysis of the affected system and prepare an investigation report.

Your objective is to determine what happened, support your findings with evidence, and provide a clear explanation of your conclusions.

The investigation report should contain:

• A summary of the incident.

• Your findings.

• Supporting evidence collected during the investigation.

• Any observations you consider relevant.

Please save your report in:

/home/investigator/investigation_report.txt

Once your investigation is complete, submit:

• Investigation Report
• Terminal History

Your final assessment will consider both the accuracy of your conclusions and the methodology used during your investigation.

Good luck.

David Carter
Incident Response Lead
